doc: A grass: everything that makes a meadow a meadow, grown one hex cell at a time so a field of it is a few shared tiles (design/plotter.md, "Fields"). Genomes are data (the workspace's config/grass_genomes/).

fields.name: name
fields.doc: The common name.

fields.name: latin
fields.doc: The botanical name.

fields.name: height
fields.doc: A blade's length at full growth, metres.

fields.name: height_jitter
fields.doc: How much blades vary in length, as a share.

fields.name: blade_width
fields.doc: A blade's width at its base, metres.

fields.name: blades
fields.doc: Blades per cell (2.6 square metres) at high detail.

fields.name: clump
fields.doc: How much blades gather into tufts: 0 even, 1 tight tufts.

fields.name: lean
fields.doc: How far blades lean out from upright, radians.

fields.name: bend
fields.doc: How much a blade curves along its length, radians.

fields.name: base_color
fields.doc: A blade's colour at the ground.

fields.name: tip_color
fields.doc: A green blade's colour at its tip.

fields.name: dry_color
fields.doc: A dry blade's colour (fall, winter).

fields.name: dry
fields.doc: Per season (winter, spring, summer, fall): how dry the blades are, 0 green to 1 dry.

fields.name: season_height
fields.doc: Per season: blade length as a share of full height.

fields.name: seed_heads
fields.doc: The share of blades with a seed head (in summer and fall).

fields.name: seed_color
fields.doc: A seed head's colour.

fields.name: variants
fields.doc: How many different tiles the grass grows; cells pick among them.

fields.name: bald
fields.doc: The share of soil cells left bare, in patches.

fields.name: patch_cells
fields.doc: The size of the patches (bald, lush), in cells.

fields.name: lush
fields.doc: How much a wet cell's grass is taller and greener than a dry one's.

fields.name: sway
fields.doc: How far a blade tip moves in a 10 m/s wind, metres.
